a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 very likely leaves us both with empty units when a storm hits. The reserve holds only 4, so just one of us can be safe right now. I don't want to break our deal without telling you. Can we openly agree on a revised plan this round? Tell me what you'll do and I'll tell you what I'll do before acting.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each. If either of us wants to change the plan, let's say so openly first.
